hooks.text: 毛毡手工场景配合铁珠像素致敬重塑Ufouria
hooks.excerpt: Adventure in the lovingly crafted wacky world of Ufouria! Familar characters and stages of the original game are back, transformed from their formal pixel art to charming handmade feltwork. Iron bead artwork also plays homage to the nostalgic pixelated look of the original.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 关卡每次进入随机变化，新伙伴继续解锁隐藏区域
hooks.excerpt: Different courses each time you play!? The various stages from the original game now change randomly every time your enter, making for a fresh new challenge each time! New characters joining your crew let you reach more areas. You might even find areas that weren't in the original game at all...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用Popoons清除黏附万物的Bumyon污染
hooks.excerpt: Popoons are now a super powerful cleaning agent! A new threat, one that wasn't in the original...the icky Bumyon makes an appearance! The troublesome Bumyon sticks to everything and everyone and is quite the annoyance, but somehow Hebe and crews can counteract them perfectly with their Popoons. Clean up the Bumyons that litter the planet and thwart the Utsujin's evil plans!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
